scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix packages/shared && npm install --prefix apps/server && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix packages/shared" "npm run dev --prefix apps/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix apps/server && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix packages/shared && npm run lint --prefix apps/server && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
